text:
sofia: Heads-up — got a spike of 413s from a client hitting /v1/embeddings when mixed-dim batches show up. Looks like our splitter creates an oversized combined payload. sample logs attached.
raj: Can you paste the raw request? is this mixed 64 + 1536 dims in same batch?
sofia: yup, payload had 12 x 64-dim + 3 x 1536-dim in same POST. client didn't pre-split. Response was a 413 with no useful routing telemetry beyond size.
morgan: ugh. we still treat bytes-only for splitter budget, not dims-weighted. that explains why the 1536s pushed it over. we need a dim-weighted preflight.
kelly: +1 for a preflight header. maybe X-Embed-Shape: [12,64],[3,1536] and a preflight endpoint /v1/embeddings/preflight that returns split-plan.
devex: client SDK should auto-split on that plan. fallback behavior: either auto-split or return 413 with split-suggestion header referencing plan id.
eng-bot: deploy status: embed-splitter v2 rolled to canary in us-west-2 (sha: ab12cd). No errors during canary.
sofia: canary didn't see these mixed batches — it's only from one large partner. need a targeted rollout and a console toggle to force dim-aware splitting.
raj: telemetry gap: our request logs only record total_bytes and item_count, not distribution of dims. we should emit one metric: embed.dim_histogram (map) or simplified: embed.max_dim and embed.avg_dim per request.
morgan: agree. minimal schema change: emit embed.max_dim and embed.weighted_tokens = sum(dims)/64 (approx token proxy). that'll let routing make better decisions.
samir: what about quota accounting? current per-request token quota is bytes-based. mixing dims lets a tiny item blow quota. we need dim-weighted quota or preflight that returns estimated quota cost.
kelly: UI ask: console quota page should show "per-dim cost estimator" and highlight requests that triggered auto-split. add sample payload modal so support can repro.
sofia: repro snippet we used:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
         Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"inputs": [ ...12 x vec64..., ...3 x vec1536...] }
```
Response: 413 Payload Too Large
Headers: X-Embed-Split-Suggestion: split_plan_2026_03_20

raj: quick mitigation: add server-side soft-fail where we accept and internally split into multiple requests with a low-priority queue. that'll be opt-in via a policy flag per customer.
morgan: soft-fail needs observability: emit batch.chunks_count and chunk.latency distribution, otherwise cost/counter surprises.
devex: rollout plan proposal:
- Phase 1 (1 week): emit embed.max_dim and weighted_tokens telemetry, implement preflight endpoint, expose split suggestion header.
- Phase 2 (2 weeks): client SDK auto-split and console toggle, soft-fail opt-in for partners causing spikes.
- Phase 3: quota model change (announce 30d) and console migration tool.
sofia: +1. can we also add a per-dim sample tracer in our logs (scrubbed) so we can reproduce in staging? partner refuses to send test data to staging without sample hashing.
raj: implement a hashed-sample field: embed.sample_sig = sha256(first32bytes) and include dims. scrubbing good.
kelly: UI wire: dashboard card showing "Mixed-dim requests" with example split-plan and button: "Open sample payload". Also onboarding tip: "Prefer per-dim batching in SDK".
samir: question re routing: should router prefer smaller-dim model variants for mixed batches or always split? i've seen quality regressions when mixing models.
morgan: prefer split. mixing model variants in a single response is risky for downstream rankers. split + stitch is safer.
devex: stitching note: add idempotency keys for chunk requests and a stitch endpoint that merges vectors in original order.
sofia: OK action items assigned:
- raj: add embed.max_dim and weighted_tokens metrics + hashed sample_sig (ETA 3d)
- morgan: implement preflight endpoint + split-suggestion header (ETA 4d)
- devex: SDK auto-split prototype + docs (ETA 1w)
- kelly: console mockups for quota estimator and mixed-dim dashboard (ETA 1w)
- samir: design soft-fail routing policy for opt-in customers (ETA 5d)
eng-bot: reminder — create JIRA EPIC: EMBEDS-1240 "Dim-aware preflight, telemetry, and UI" (assignee: platform)
sofia: thanks team. i'll ping partner with a short mitigation to ask them to enable client SDK auto-split or reduce max per-request dims until we have soft-fail. :thumbsup:

raj: filing a follow-up thread for quota math once metrics land. good catch, sofia.
